1.explanation:
1. TimePicker/TimePicker.mdx & overview.mdx – show the existing implementation and usage of the TimePicker component (including the text input cell that needs updated borders and icons).
2. TimePickerSelect/TimePickerSelect.mdx & overview.mdx – describe the AM/PM and timezone dropdown parts, so we can confirm that only the text input cell styling changes and that dropdowns remain unchanged.
3. TextInput/TextInput.mdx & overview.mdx – detail Carbon’s established error state styling (border color, icon, message) and the new warning state guidelines for text inputs, which we must mirror in the TimePicker’s text‐entry cell.
1.bug_scenario: The design update requires that the TimePicker’s text‐entry cell show both “error” and a new “warning” state, styled consistently with Carbon’s other form components. In the error state, the time input box gets a 2px red border, a red error icon flush to the right of the entered time, and a red error message beneath. In the warning state, the same input box shows a yellow warning icon (with identical spacing rules) and a warning message below. Spacing callouts in the spec call for an 8px gap between the time text and the icon container, and a 16px (1rem) icon container width. The AM/PM and timezone dropdowns are unaffected but must remain aligned.
